current: Two partial carriers. qip_contracts::message::MarketMessage (backend/crates/libs/qip-contracts/src/message.rs:163-203) is the edge's canonical venue message: object_id (instrument), Origin {venue, feed, partition, sequence} with stream_key() and directly_follows() for gap detection (qip-contracts/src/venue.rs:141-172), body (MessageBody, the event type), venue_time (exchange time) and capture_time (receive time). qip-sequencing's tracker detects and abandons gaps per stream, and its clock estimator publishes an offset with uncertainty (qip-sequencing/src/clock.rs:18,70). Reached from qip-edge-node (src/feed.rs). Centrally, qip_market::quote::{Quote, Trade, Tick} (qip-market/src/quote.rs) are EventBodies with venue, one timestamp, price/size and mandatory DataQuality, and MarketEventEnvelope (qip-market-ingestion/src/connector/envelope.rs:86-140) carries event/ingest/knowable time, a fingerprint and Provenance.
gap: No single canonical MarketEvent. The type with sequence and exchange/receive times (MarketMessage) is edge-only. The central tick types have one timestamp and no sequence, and MarketEventEnvelope conflates exchange and receive time into event_time. No type carries a normalized time with its uncertainty: qip-sequencing's clock estimate is per venue and never stamped on an event. No payload hash or payload lineage on the market event, and no entitlement field. Canonical tick capture and book reconstruction for the first market (master Phase 1) is not wired through either type into a replayable store.

current: Pieces exist, not packaged together. qip_lifecycle::evidence::DatasetManifest (backend/crates/services/qip-lifecycle/src/evidence.rs:345-400) pins subject (a one-instrument universe), venue, bar count, time window (first_open/last_open) and a SHA-256 over the bars' canonical encoding, refusing a manifest with no bars or a hash nobody computed. It is produced by qip_kernel::central::foundry::recorded_manifest (foundry.rs:363), called from qip-deepbrain's evolution round (backend/crates/apps/qip-deepbrain/src/evolution.rs:1350), which runs every 4 cycles by default. qip_simulation_engine::backtest::BacktestConfig (backtest.rs:75-84) separately pins cost, execution (decision_lag, allow_same_bar_fill) and impact-window assumptions, and Context::deterministic supplies seeded randomness. `qip replay --journal` (qip-cli/src/replay.rs) checks log integrity, not a backtest.
gap: No ReplayManifest type binds data, universe, window, assumptions, model versions and seeds under one reproducibility hash. DatasetManifest's hash covers the bars only, so changing a fill, impact, latency or seed assumption does not change it, which is exactly what the requirement's replay check tests. Clock, latency and queue assumptions are not modelled (ExecutionAssumptions is decision lag plus a same-bar flag), and model versions and seeds are not recorded against a run. Tick-level replay for the first market is not what DatasetManifest describes (bars).
